description: List the tenant's vendors: id, name, code, contact/email/phone, and the default lead time (days) the reorder engine uses when no item-specific or historical lead time exists, plus any custom field values set on the vendor (customFields, keyed by fieldName — see list_custom_fields with entity=businessPartner), and measured performance from the vendor's completed POs issued in the last 12 months: lead time mean ± σ (leadTimeMeanDays, leadTimeStdDevDays, leadTimeSampleCount) and on-time % against the promised due date (onTimePercent, meanDaysLate, onTimeSampleCount); each is null until its stated minimum order count is met. Optional case-insensitive search substring (name/code/email/contact); paged (Total pre-paging + limit/offset, default 100, max 500). Requires an operator (unpinned) org token — vendors are tenant-shared operator facts, not client-scoped. Tax, VAT and bank account details are omitted unless includeFinancialDetails=true; request these only for a user's explicit financial-detail query.

includeFinancialDetails.description: Include vendor tax, VAT and bank account details only when the user explicitly requests those details (default false).

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against vendor name, code, email, or contact name.

name: list_suppliers
title: List Vendors
